newsitem.title: USA: CME feeder cattle up sharply on grain break, stops.
newsitem.headline: CME feeder cattle up sharply on grain break, stops.

text.p: CME feeder cattle futures ran up for sharp gains following a break in CBOT grain futures with buy stops adding to the advance, traders said.
April feeders jumped as much as 1.325 cents a lb before meeting resistance. Futures are currently 0.400 to 1.175 higher with Mary up 0.925 at 69.375 cents.
Feeders had been supported since the start of trade today and a further setback in grain futures reinforced demand.
Corn futures were down following a break in soybeans, they said.
